from pydicom.dataset import Dataset, FileMetaDataset

ds = Dataset()
ds.file_meta = FileMetaDataset()

ds.BitsAllocated = 32
ds.SamplesPerPixel = 1

ds.Columns = 5
ds.PhotometricInterpretation = 'MONOCHROME2'

pixel_array = np.zeros((ds.Rows, ds.Columns), dtype=np.float32)
ds.FloatPixelData = pixel_array.flatten().tobytes()

result = np.array_equal(ds.pixel_array, pixel_array)
print("Script completed successfully, no errors. Result:", result)
